scholarships.title: Beca Posgrado STEM Regional (Fulbright-Garcia Robles) - COMEXUS
scholarships.official_source: U.S.-Mexico Commission for Educational and Cultural Exchange (COMEXUS), the Fulbright Commission in Mexico

existing.description: The Beca Posgrado STEM Regional is a Fulbright-Garcia Robles postgraduate scholarship run by COMEXUS, the U.S.-Mexico Commission for Educational and Cultural Exchange, for Mexican nationals who originate from and live in the interior of Mexico outside Mexico City, Guadalajara, Monterrey and their metropolitan areas. It funds a master's or doctorate in science, technology, engineering and mathematics at a US university for students starting in August 2028, with up to USD 37,000 per academic year for master's study lasting up to 18 months and up to USD 25,000 per academic year for doctoral study lasting up to three years, plus help with admission applications at up to five universities. The call is open from 2 September 2026 to 15 January 2027 and requires an intermediate level of English; applicants holding a US nationality or residence, or already admitted to a US university, are excluded.
eligibility: Mexican nationality (the award is granted to students with Mexican nationality)

Be a native of and reside in the interior of the Republic, excluding those originating in or residing in Mexico City, Monterrey or Guadalajara and their metropolitan areas; applicants who moved temporarily to study postgraduate studies in those cities remain eligible
Study only in Science, Technology, Engineering or Mathematics (STEM)
Have an intermediate level of English
Not already hold an admission from a university
Not hold a conditional acceptance requiring an English course at the US university that accepted them
Not hold US residence or US nationality, including dual Mexican-US nationality
existing.eligibility_summary: Mexican nationals who originate from and reside in the interior of the Republic of Mexico, excluding Mexico City, Guadalajara, Monterrey and their metropolitan areas, who want to study a master's or doctorate in STEM subjects in the United States and who have an intermediate level of English.
benefits: Up to USD 37,000 per school year for master's degrees, for a maximum of 18 months
Up to USD 25,000 per school year for doctorates, for a maximum of three years
Commission assistance with the admission application process (payment and tracking) at up to five universities
coverage: Up to USD 37,000 per academic year for up to 18 months of master's study
Up to USD 25,000 per academic year for up to three years of doctoral study
Support with the university admission application process, including payment and follow-up, at up to five universities
requirements: Apply during the published window and be able to begin studies in August 2028
Have an intermediate level of English
Apply directly to US universities; COMEXUS supports the admission process at up to five universities
Meet the exclusion rules: no prior US university admission, no conditional admission requiring an English course, no US residence or nationality
documents: Completed online application with all required fields and documents
Evidence of residence and origin in the interior of the Republic, outside the excluded metropolitan areas
Evidence of an intermediate level of English
Documents required by the US universities applied to
existing.english_requirement: Intermediate level of English, stated in the official call description ('que cuenten con un nivel intermedio de ingles')
application_method: Apply online through the COMEXUS application system during the published window
Apply to US universities with COMEXUS support for the admission process at up to five universities
Complete the COMEXUS selection process for studies beginning August 2028
existing.selection_notes: COMEXUS administers the Fulbright-Garcia Robles programme jointly with the US Department of State and the Mexican Secretariat of Foreign Affairs; the published programme description gives priority considerations in the companion Posgrado Regular call to STEM and to studies about the United States.
existing.best_fit: Mexican nationals living outside the three largest metropolitan areas who hold an intermediate level of English and need support to begin a STEM master's or doctorate at a US university in August 2028.
existing.notes:
This is the regional variant of the COMEXUS postgraduate scholarship: it excludes applicants from Mexico City, Guadalajara and Monterrey, so it targets residents of the rest of Mexico. It is a different call from the Beca Posgrado Regular, which has no geographic exclusion.
Funding period: per academic year (USD 37,000 for master's up to 18 months; USD 25,000 for doctorates up to three years)
existing.duration: Master's: up to 18 months. Doctorate: up to three years.
existing.application_period: 2 September 2026 to 15 January 2027; studies must begin in August 2028 without exception
existing.deadline_display: 15 January 2027 (call open from 2 September 2026), for studies starting August 2028 without exception
existing.program_type: Bilateral government exchange scholarship (United States-Mexico commission)
